sn-0GE3.title: Coverage: sandy road with sparse trees
sn-0GE3.summary: The only region with plenty of rural coverage: the car drives on sandy roads with sparse trees. Sand near the big holy city is more grassy.

sn-0Upt.title: Coverage: hazy, low sun, some farmland
sn-0Upt.summary: Hazy coverage with a low sun, passing through partly farmed land, on the main road in the far north.

sn-2NXs.title: Roadside: tall bright yellow grass patches
sn-2NXs.summary: Distinct tall patches of bright yellow grass beside the road, mostly in the east.

sn-6ZX7.title: Vegetation: lush and green, palms near coast
sn-6ZX7.summary: In the far south, vegetation is much greener and more lush than elsewhere, with palm trees near the coast. Don't confuse it with the greenish coast near the capital, where plants look lower.

sn-7wNV.title: Road items: French-style bollards, poles, signs
sn-7wNV.summary: As a former French colony, it uses French-style bollards, poles, signs and road lines.

sn-8e0Q.title: Google car: roof rack and right mirror, Gen 3
sn-8e0Q.summary: In Gen 3 coverage you can see the roof rack and the right side mirror, plus rifts in the sky. The visible mirror is unique to this country, but roof racks and rifts appear elsewhere.

sn-9fep.title: Google car: silver or white truck cab (Gen 4)
sn-9fep.summary: Gen 4 coverage shows a silver or white truck cab, in several variants that are mostly tied to certain regions or roads. Near the capital there is also a black pick-up. The car can be fully blurred, so check the landscape too.

sn-ERgE.title: Landscape: flat, dry savannah, short pale trees
sn-ERgE.summary: Flat, dry savannah-desert with sparse, fairly short trees whose leaves are faded in colour. This is the look for most of the country.

sn-FeHb.title: Landscape: greener with bigger hills
sn-FeHb.summary: In the southeast: a greener landscape with larger hills.

sn-GNSK.title: Language: French
sn-GNSK.summary: The main language on signs is French. Other sub-Saharan countries with coverage use English, apart from Rwanda, where the landscape tells them apart.

differs.how: Rwanda also has some French but looks very different

sn-Ilre.title: Coverage: dirt road in evening light
sn-Ilre.summary: A dirt road shot in late afternoon to evening light, getting later towards the west.

sn-L65q.title: Landscape: wide road, desert
sn-L65q.summary: A wide road through flat desert with very few trees and bright blue, cloudless skies. The higher the sun, the further east you are.

sn-NOh2.title: Driving side: right
sn-NOh2.summary: Traffic drives on the right. Useful against Kenya, which drives on the left. Ghana, Nigeria, Rwanda and Tunisia also drive on the right.

sn-OEuy.title: Google car: silver Gen 4
sn-OEuy.summary: Silver Gen 4 truck with a long antenna at the front left, found on many roads but not past the eastern edge of one central region. The antenna shows even when the car is blurred.

sn-OYbz.title: Plate: fully blue plate
sn-OYbz.summary: The only African country with fully blue licence plates. Newer plates in Gen 4 coverage look like the standard European plate: white with a blue strip on the left.

sn-QgQm.title: Landscape: flat, slightly marshy, low plants
sn-QgQm.summary: A flat, slightly marshy landscape with low vegetation on a few roads in a river delta.

sn-S2AA.title: Taxis: yellow-orange with black fenders
sn-S2AA.summary: Yellow-orange taxis with black fenders are common.

sn-UFZN.title: City: dense, tall modern buildings
sn-UFZN.summary: The capital is the biggest city, with dense streets and taller, more modern buildings.

sn-WDIx.title: Landscape: dry with slight hills
sn-WDIx.summary: A dry landscape with slight hills, mostly in the far east and a bit south of it.

sn-aMed.title: Fields: irrigated rice
sn-aMed.summary: Irrigated rice fields can sometimes be seen in the north, between two towns near the river.

sn-cfOC.title: Road: runs northeast, railway alongside
sn-cfOC.summary: A road running roughly northeast with a railway beside it. The railway is south of the road at first, then switches to the north.

sn-dxl9.title: Google car: plain white Gen 4
sn-dxl9.summary: The regular white Gen 4 car is mostly in the south, but also on the northeast coast and in one small western area.

sn-irXP.title: Coverage: hazy bushfire smoke
sn-irXP.summary: A road in the southeast with hazy bushfire coverage, sometimes smoke trails in the distance. It is paved in the southern part.

sn-kDY5.title: Road: bright orange dirt, dry brown hills, haze
sn-kDY5.summary: A white-looking road of bright orange dirt through a dry, slightly hilly landscape with brown vegetation and noticeable haze.

sn-lPzT.title: Sign: white town sign, thick pink outline
sn-lPzT.summary: Most town entry signs are white with a thick pink outline and the town name in bold black letters.

sn-lm-22659.title: Bollard: round white post, pointed top, band
sn-lm-22659.summary: Very common round white post with a pointed top and a reflector band all the way round, grey or red. A rare version has a fully red top. It is the French-style bollard.

sn-lm-446365.title: Google car: silver Gen 4 with box on back right
sn-lm-446365.summary: Silver Gen 4 truck with a box at the back right of the cab. Seen mainly on roads in the north and along the dirt road beside the northern border, plus a few other roads.

sn-lm-446366.title: Google car: silver Gen 4, stain back left
sn-lm-446366.summary: Silver Gen 4 truck with a stain at the back left of the cab, seen in the north and east.

sn-lm-446367.title: Google car: silver Gen 4, stain and dirty roof
sn-lm-446367.summary: Silver Gen 4 truck with a stain at the back left and a dirty roof, seen mainly on main roads in the centre and southeast.

sn-lm-446368.title: Google car: silver Gen 4, red cloth front left
sn-lm-446368.summary: Silver Gen 4 truck with a red cloth at the front left, seen on one road in the northeast.

sn-lm-446369.title: Google car: white Gen 4, antenna folded flat
sn-lm-446369.summary: White Gen 4 car with the antenna laid down parallel to the roof, seen on one road in the south.

sn-lm-446370.title: Google car: white Gen 4, dirty back
sn-lm-446370.summary: White Gen 4 car with a noticeably dirty back, seen on a road in the south.

sn-n0Eo.title: Coverage: mostly west, few side roads in east
sn-n0Eo.summary: Most coverage is in the west. In the east only the main roads are covered.

sn-niwG.title: Road: divided highway, no road number
sn-niwG.summary: Divided highways only exist between the capital and the holy city, and between the capital and a coastal town. On Google Maps they are yellow roads with no number, and none exist in Gen 3.

sn-nmqJ.title: Landscape: gently rolling vegetated dunes
sn-nmqJ.summary: Very slightly rolling land of vegetated sand dunes along the northwest coast.

sn-t5k7.title: Street lamps: black with solar panel on top
sn-t5k7.summary: Simple black lamp posts with a solar panel on top are common.

sn-wdji.title: Km marker: white with red top, towns listed
sn-wdji.summary: White kilometre markers with a red top, showing the road number and distances to nearby towns. The farthest town listed is usually the largest.

sn-z3L1.title: Landmark: mosque with five tall minarets
sn-z3L1.summary: A famous mosque in the holy city has five tall minarets and can be seen from far away.
